Unset data_as_elements uses span and div for data-as

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = '<div><span data-as="p">First</span><span data-as="p">Second</span></div>'
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
